with base as (
select
:Year || '-' || :Month || '-' || :Day as period,
fsre.reference_no, fsreS.reference_no as sup_ref_no, fsreR.reference_no as Rev_ref_no,fsre.SUPERSEDING_REGULATION_ID,
fsre.fsre_id, rt.type_name_eng as reg_type, rst.type_name_Eng as status, mmno.section_text_eng as mm_notes,
fsre.effective_Datetime, fsre.expiry_Datetime, fsre.superseded_datetime, fsre.updated_date, fsre.created_Date, spp.common_name_eng as SPECIES,
species_Group_name_eng, fsre.areas, fsre.sub_Areas, fsre.minsize_cm, fsre.daily_limit_pc, fsre.posession_limit_pc, 
fsre.annual_limit_pc, fsre.closed_yn, fsre.non_retention_yn, fsre.opening_closure_areas, fsre.all_species_limits, fsre.description, 
fsre.areas_id_list as str1, fsre.sub_areas_id_list as str2
FROM   fris_v2.fishery_species_regulations@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink  fsre
left join fris_v2.species@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink spp on fsre.species_id = spp.spec_id
left join fris_v2.SPECIES_GROUPS@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink sppG on fsre.species_group_id = sppG.spgr_id
left join fris_v2.REGULATION_STATUS_TYPES@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink rst on fsre.regulation_Status_type_id = rst.rsty_id
left join fris_v2.REGULATION_TYPES@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink rt on fsre.regulation_type_id = rt.regty_id
left join fris_v2.MANAGEMENT_MEASURE_NOTES_VW@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink mmno on mmno.fishery_species_regulation_id = fsre.fsre_id
left join fris_v2.fishery_species_regulations@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink  fsreS on fsre.SUPERSEDING_REGULATION_ID = fsreS.fsre_id
left join fris_v2.fishery_species_regulations@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink  fsreR on fsre.REVOKES_REGULATION_ID = fsreR.fsre_id
where 1=1
and rt.regty_id in (61, 62, 81, 161, 162, 163)
and rst.rsty_id  in (2, 4)
           and to_date(:Year || '-' || :Month || '-' || :Day,'YYYY-MM-DD') between fsre.effective_Datetime and nvl(fsre.superseded_Datetime,fsre.expiry_datetime)
           order by  fsre.fsre_id desc, fsre.reference_no nulls first
           )

    , rowdata2 as (
    select  t.fsre_id,t.str1 as str,  trim(regexp_substr(t.str1, '[^,]+', 1, levels.column_value))  as fmar_id_id, 'PFMA' as area_type
from base t, table(cast(multiset(select level from dual connect by  level <= length (regexp_replace(t.str1, '[^,]+'))  + 1) as sys.OdciNumberList)) levels
union
    select  t.fsre_id,t.str2,  trim(regexp_substr(t.str2, '[^,]+', 1, levels.column_value))  as fmar_id_id, 'PFMA Sub' as area_type
from base t, table(cast(multiset(select level from dual connect by  level <= length (regexp_replace(t.str2, '[^,]+'))  + 1) as sys.OdciNumberList)) levels
)
 , rslt2 as (   select rowdata2.fsre_id, rowdata2.str as areas_id_list, fmar.fmar_id, fmar.area_name_eng as area_name, rowdata2.area_type , fmarP.area_name_eng as parent_area_nme
    from rowdata2  
    left join fris_v2.FISHERY_MGMT_AREAS@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink fmar on rowdata2.fmar_id_id = fmar.fmar_id
    left join fris_v2.FISHERY_MGMT_AREAS@pacific_lakehouse_fris_v2_dblink fmarP on fmar.parent_fishery_mgmt_area_id = fmarP.fmar_id
    where rowdata2.str is not null
    )
          
, final as ( select b.*, case when r.area_type = 'PFMA' then r.area_name else r.parent_area_nme end as PFMA, r.area_name, r.area_type 
 from base b 
 left join rslt2 r on b.fsre_id = r.fsre_id
 )
 
 
 , sum1 as ( 
select  
 period,
 reference_no,
 reg_type,
 case when SPECIES like '%Chinook%' then 'Chinook' when SPECIES like '%Coho%' then 'Coho' else SPECIES end as species, 
 PFMA as area_name,
 closed_yn,
 non_retention_yn,
 max(minsize_cm) as minsize_cm, 
 case when max(nvl(daily_limit_pc,0)) = 0 then null else max(nvl(daily_limit_pc,0)) end as daily_limit_pc, 
 case when max(nvl(posession_limit_pc,0)) = 0 then null else  max(nvl(posession_limit_pc,0)) end as posession_limit_pc,
 case when max(nvl(annual_limit_pc,0)) = 0 then null else max(nvl(annual_limit_pc,0)) end as annual_limit_pc, 
 LISTAGG(case when area_type = 'PFMA Sub' then SUBSTR(area_name, INSTR(area_name, '-') + 1) end, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY area_type) AS pfma_sub_list,
 count(*) as rws, pfma
 from final 
 where 1=1
 and (daily_limit_pc is not null or annual_limit_pc is not null)
 and (SPECIES in ('Halibut', 'Lingcod') or species like '%Chinook%' or SPECIES like '%Coho%')
 group by period,
 reference_no,
 reg_type,
 case when SPECIES like '%Chinook%' then 'Chinook' when SPECIES like '%Coho%' then 'Coho' else SPECIES end,
 PFMA,
 non_retention_yn,closed_yn
)
, sum2 as (
select period, species, 'A' || substr('00' || pfma,-3) as area_name, max(daily_limit_pc) as daily_limit_pc,
max(annual_limit_pc) as annual_limit_pc, listagg(distinct non_retention_yn, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY non_retention_yn)  as non_retention,
listagg(distinct closed_yn, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closed_yn)  as closed_yn, PFMA
from sum1    
group by period, species, area_name
order by species
)
, sum3 as (select * from sum2
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A002E' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '2'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A002W' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '2'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A019IR' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '19'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A019MP' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '19'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A019SI' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '19'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A020E' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '20'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A020W' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '20'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A023AI' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '23'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A023BS' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '23'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A029GS' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '29'
union
select PERIOD, SPECIES, 'A029IR' as AREA_NAME, DAILY_LIMIT_PC, ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC, NON_RETENTION, CLOSED_YN, PFMA from sum2 where pfma = '29'
)

/*select * from sum3 
order by cast(pfma as number), species*/
